title: Will Scild
kicker: A slow-moving Sablewood merchant nobody disturbs, known for carrying valuable goods and tossing a small stone between his hands.
hook: A slow-moving Sablewood merchant nobody disturbs, known for carrying valuable goods and tossing a small stone between his hands.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A turtle-folk merchant in a blue road scarf carries shell packs, brass medallions, and a smooth stone he tosses as if time belongs to him.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Calm as geology. Tosses an ordinary river stone because it is the one thing in his pack nobody has ever tried to tax. Stays independent in a forest that keeps trying to itemize independence.

blocks.body: A question to ask A local perspective A grounded reason this place matters
